locations.name: Bajrang Setu (Glass Floor Bridge)
locations.famous_for: India's first glass-floor suspension bridge; replacement for the historic Laxman Jhula.
locations.details: Spans 132 meters with 1.5-meter-wide reinforced glass walkways on both sides.
locations.how_to_reach: Located near the original Laxman Jhula site. Walkable from Tapovan or accessible by auto-rickshaw.
locations.status_2026: Operational (occasionally closed for minor maintenance; check locally).

locations.name: Lakshman Jhula & Ram Jhula
locations.famous_for: Iconic iron suspension bridges; spiritual and cultural landmarks.
locations.how_to_reach: Accessible by walking, motorbike, or shared auto-rickshaws.
locations.status_2026: Lakshman Jhula restricted for safety; pedestrian traffic encouraged on Bajrang Setu or Ram Jhula.

locations.name: Triveni Ghat
locations.famous_for: Sacred bathing spot and the most powerful evening Maha Ganga Aarti.
locations.timings_2026: Summer: 6:00 PM - 7:00 PM | Winter: 5:30 PM - 6:30 PM

locations.name: The Beatles Ashram (Chaurasi Kutia)
locations.famous_for: Ruins where The Beatles learned Transcendental Meditation in 1968.
locations.timings_2026: Summer: 10:00 AM - 4:30 PM | Winter: 10:00 AM - 3:30 PM

locations.name: Kunjapuri Devi Temple
locations.famous_for: Panoramic Himalayan sunrise views from 1676m altitude.
things_to_do: Downhill trek to Neer Garh (8-9 km)
locations.how_to_reach: 25-30 km from Rishikesh; depart at 4:00 AM by taxi for sunrise.
locations.fees_2026: Temple entry free; guided sunrise tours ₹2500 - ₹4000.

locations.name: Jumpin Heights (Mohan Chatti)
locations.famous_for: India's premier bungee jumping destination (83 meters).

locations.name: Neer Garh & Garud Chatti Waterfalls
locations.famous_for: Multi-tiered natural waterfalls and secluded jungle pools.
locations.trek_difficulty: Neer Garh: Easy-Moderate (1.5 km hike) | Garud Chatti: Secluded/Quiet

locations.name: Vashishta Gufa (Cave)
locations.famous_for: Ancient meditation cave of Sage Vashishta; sanctuary of silence.

locations.name: Rajaji National Park (Chilla Zone)
locations.famous_for: Wildlife safaris; spotting elephants, leopards, and diverse birds.
locations.timings: Morning: 7:00 AM - 10:00 AM | Afternoon: 2:30 PM - 5:30 PM
